title: History of Zura Massage
summary: How Zura Massage was created — a holistic massage for deep muscular relaxation and stress relief, using firm pressure and Swedish, deep tissue, Thai, and other Zura techniques.

sections.title: History of Zura Massage
paragraphs: Zura Massage was designed by the Executive Director of Zura Spa, Delight Olga, out of a desire to restore massage therapy as a profession of passion, care, and genuine service, not just a way to make money.

She saw the need to create a massage experience that focuses on the client’s comfort, relaxation, body relief, and overall wellness. Zura Massage was therefore developed to help therapists understand that massage is not only about applying pressure to the body, but about creating a calm, professional, respectful, and healing experience for every client.

The goal behind Zura Massage is to uphold a high standard of service. Every session should be done with care, attention, discipline, hygiene, and proper technique. A client should not only receive a massage, but should feel relaxed, valued, respected, and renewed after the experience.

From this vision, the professional identity of the Zura Wellness Professional was created. A Zura Wellness Professional is not just a massage therapist. A Zura Wellness Professional is someone who understands the importance of wellness, client care, professionalism, hygiene, emotional intelligence, and continuous improvement.

sections.title: About Zura Massage
paragraphs: Zura Massage is a holistic massage designed to promote deep muscular relaxation and relieve stress. It is Zura Spa's signature holistic and therapeutic body massage, and it also aims to help clients feel calm and refreshed.
The massage uses firm pressure, combining techniques from Swedish, deep tissue massage, Thai massage and other Zura techniques for a balanced and effective experience.
The session can begin with an optional 5-minute massage chair session and an optional 2-minute mind relaxation game to help the client fully unwind before the massage begins.

Zura Massage is built on proper preparation, professional conduct, client comfort, hygiene, and attention to detail. It is not rushed, careless, or ordinary. It is designed to make the client feel safe, listened to, and well cared for.

The purpose of Zura Massage is to help clients relax their body, calm their mind, ease tension, and enjoy a peaceful wellness experience. Every Zura Wellness Professional is expected to deliver this service with passion, patience, discipline, and respect for the Zura Spa standard.
